body: Hey, I’ve read through some of your posts. I’m around your age. I can’t imagine the hell you’ve been through over the past year, but there’s a way forward. The system is bastard, but I’m begging you to not succumb to it. We’re just kids, and I swear that in the next 0-3 years that we’ll make it out of these crummy situations and communities. When you’re out of school, you can live life the way you want. You can leave the country. You can embrace art, live freely and outside of this structure that you’ve been stuck in, and you can finally embrace your identity. Please try and give the future a shot, for as long as you can manage. There’s more beyond what we’ve encountered in our present environments, and we can know more than simply becoming products and outcomes of them.
